description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - sign reader: aim at a far sign (bus stop, departure gate, menu, road sign), take a telephoto photo, and READ sends the photo to the host language model as a data: URL image (the official read-text path - there is no OCR), returning the sign's KEY line big on screen plus a full transcription, labelled a machine read that may misread. DICT lets you dictate what YOU read as a literal cross-check - MATCH or DIFF on screen - and SPEAK reads the key line aloud, preferring your version when they differ. Session only: photos are never saved and nothing is stored
name: sign-reader
